info.name: LaunchDarkly Relay Proxy Access Tokens Server-Side Evaluation API
Evaluate all flags for a context (GET)

params.name: contextBase64
params.description: A base64-encoded JSON representation of the evaluation context.

items.docs: Evaluates all feature flags for the given context and returns the results. The context is provided as a base64-encoded JSON object in the URL path. Requires an SDK key in the Authorization header.
